_comment: oxlint warnings that are accepted, one entry per file and rule (#150, Decision 2). scripts/static_checks.py fails on any warning not listed here for its context, and on an entry that lists more warnings than the file now has, so the list cannot go stale. 'file' is relative to the directory oxlint runs in (web/ or workers/scan-proxy/). Fix a warning rather than listing it where the fix is small; every entry needs a reason.
